# EryyynIT (Michael Barkalov)

> Backend developer working in Go and Python (FastAPI). Builds production
> backend systems, experiments with infrastructure and AI, and develops an
> indie game on the side.

Michael Barkalov (online as EryyynIT) is a backend developer based in
Voronezh, Russia, with commercial experience in Go and Python/FastAPI.
He has functioned as tech lead on an NDA web platform project and
solo-built ADNova, a commercial AdTech/CPA backend. He is currently
finishing a technical college program in mechatronics and mobile
robotics (graduating 2026) and is targeting remote backend roles.

## Key pages

- [Resume](https://eryyynit.github.io/resume/): Professional experience,
  skills, and downloadable CV (EN/RU).
- [About](https://eryyynit.github.io/about/): Background on Michael /
  EryyynIT — who he is, what he builds, and why.
- [Projects](https://eryyynit.github.io/#projects): Selected work,
  including ADNova (commercial AdTech backend), an event-driven payment
  microservice (FastAPI/RabbitMQ), and a Go queue broker.
- [UndeadOverhaul](https://eryyynit.github.io/game/): A two-person indie
  game in active development (Godot, Rust/gdext).
